exercises.name: Barbell Squat
exercises.description: A fundamental lower-body strength exercise targeting the quads, hamstrings, glutes, and lower back, offering benefits like increased power, endurance, and stability.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.description: A strength exercise that lifts weight from the floor to hip level, primarily targeting the posterior chain (glutes, hamstrings, and back).

exercises.name: Dumbell Bench Press
exercises.description: A strength training exercise that primarily targets the chest muscles, along with the triceps and shoulders.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.description: A closed-chain movement where the body is suspended by the hands, gripping a bar or other implement at a distance typically wider than shoulder-width, and pulled up.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.description: A compound upper-body exercise targeting the chest, triceps, and shoulders, used to build strength in powerlifting and bodybuilding.
